effective_date_basis: Section 3 makes revocations effective on the common effective date of the initial regulations issued by the Budget Director and GSA Administrator. That date is absent from this original; signing March 27, 1962 is not substituted.
effective_date_trigger: Common effective date of initial regulations issued by the Budget Director and Administrator of General Services under EO11012.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Section 4 continues existing Budget Director regulations until superseded pursuant to this order. The actual initial-regulation effective date must be established before asserting an exact revocation date.
leads: Locate both initial regulations and their common effective date.
Section 4 expressly continues existing regulations until their separate supersession.

legal_effect: Research lead only. Express revocation/supersession does not establish first substantive cessation, extinguish saved effects or change any provisional status.
